H_i_max_calibration.rationale: The methodology defines H_i_max without numerical calibration. A constant avoids unsupported driver-level heterogeneity. The project baseline is 10 minutes; it is not manuscript-derived or an authoritative source value.
H_i_max_calibration.runtime_alias: Explicit persisted copy of H_i_max_minutes; no runtime default.

fare_validity: finite fare_amount > 0 and pickup timestamp before cutoff
persistence: fixed per driver for complete simulation
